title: Prompt Weave Strata: Calibration Pack Curation for FP8/INT8
creator: Asha Rao
description: Create a reproducible, per-domain calibration dataset curation and sampling strategy to support FP8 and INT8 quantization profiles used in production. The goal is to produce compact per-domain "packs" of prompts and contexts that preserve distributional properties important to accuracy under low-precision execution, while keeping pack sizes small enough for fast calibration runs and iterative validation. This ticket defines the "Prompt Weave Strata" approach (hybrid hash-bucketing + stratified reservoir with recency and rarity weighting), the end-to-end calibration workflow, and the acceptance criteria for automated accuracy validation.
acceptance_criteria: Per-domain calibration packs generated for 12 high-volume domains with target size 5k examples each
Calibration runs using FP8 and INT8 profiles must show <2% change in key downstream metrics for high-impact intents compared to full-precision baseline on nightly regression harness
Deterministic pack generation with documented seed and pipeline, reproducible on CI and local dev machines
Evaluation harness implements automated tiered checks (statistical, token-level, and human spot checks) and CI gating for new quant profiles
design_decisions: Use hybrid 'weave' sampler: locality-preserving hashing (LSH) to group semantically similar prompts, then stratified reservoir sampling across intent buckets and token-length bands
Anchorless augmentation: avoid over-reliance on single exemplar anchors per cohort to reduce single-point failure when anchor prompts are outlier-like
Recency bias: apply a calibrated exponential decay weight (lambda=0.7 over a 90-day window) to emphasize recent traffic while preserving stability
Per-tenant scaling: sample proportionally by tenant footprint but enforce a minimum floor per-tenant to ensure minority tenants are represented
Target 70/20/10 split for pack composition: 70% live-production traffic, 20% synthetic/edge-case generators, 10% curated rare-intent examples
sampling_strategy: Step 1 - Preprocessing: dedupe by (user_id masked, normalized prompt, canonicalized metadata), compute embeddings using embed-service v2, attach token_count and intent_label if available
Step 2 - LSH weave: map embeddings into 1024 hash-buckets, then within each bucket compute intent and length strata
Step 3 - Stratified reservoir: for each (bucket, intent, length) cell run reservoir sampling with cell-level weights derived from traffic volume and rarity score
Step 4 - Recency reweight: apply exponential decay multiplier to reservoir scores before final selection
Step 5 - Diversity clamp: enforce Jaccard/semantic-similarity threshold to avoid near-duplicates across the pack (threshold 0.85), with fallback replacement from same-cell pool
Deterministic seeding: PRNG seed stored per-pack in metadata to allow exact rebuilds
calibration_workflow: Pack generation pipeline (Airflow/K8s job) outputs JSONL with metadata columns: pack_id, domain, seed, selection_reason, original_timestamp, tenant_id_hashed, token_count
Calibration runner: for each pack run FP8 and INT8 calibration jobs with runtime-1.21 calibration harness, record layer-wise scale factors and histograms
Reference run: run same pack at FP16 baseline to produce golden outputs and logits for comparison
Automatic regressions: compute per-token KL, top-k match rate, and answer F1 for structured-response tasks
Human review: sample 200 examples per domain for manual triage when automated checks flag >1% regression
accuracy_validation_plan: Primary metrics: token-level KL divergence, top-1 token agreement, sequence-level answer F1 (for labeled tasks), and downstream intent accuracy (where labels exist)
Secondary metrics: embedding drift (cosine distance between FP16 and quantized embedding outputs), latency and perf regressions during calibration runs
Regression thresholds: KL per-token <0.03 (avg), top-1 agreement >98% for high-volume intents, sequence F1 drop <2% relative to baseline
Tiered gating: green (pass all thresholds), amber (minor breaches -> manual triage and black-box test), red (fail -> rollback profile and alert SRE + ML owners)
Continuous monitoring: nightly batch validation, weekly adversarial augmentation runs (synthetic edge-cases), and post-deploy sampled A/B check against production traffic
implementation_tasks: Build pack generator microservice and seed-stamping (Python + Spark/Dataproc) - PR: github.com/redwood-inference/calib-gen/pull/112
Add LSH and cell stratifier library to internal sampling toolkit (npm package 'rwd-sampler')
Extend calibration harness to emit detailed histograms and per-layer scale factors (runtime-1.21 change request)
Integrate CI regression checks into 'quant-profiles' pipeline and add gating job in GitHub Actions
Create Confluence doc 'Prompt Weave Strata: design + runbook' and attach pack examples for each domain

notes: Pack size targets are adjustable; start with 5k examples/domain and iterate based on calibration signal-to-noise.
Synthetic generators should be seeded from the same PRNG to keep augmentation reproducible.
We should coordinate with Console team to surface per-pack drift metrics in the rollout dashboard.
